newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin jumps on higher LME, foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: KL tin jumps on higher LME, foreign demand.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose 21 cents to end at its psychological level of 14 ringgit ($5.56) a kg after a higher London market encouraged more overseas demand.
"The market fell too much in recent days. Active buying from Europe lifted prices from previous days low," a trader said.
The rise also reflected a technical adjustment to recent days' lows, they said, adding that more buying emerged as the market reached the psychological level of 14 ringgit.
Turnover rose to 116 tonnes from 71 on Monday. The local price premium over London was $95 a tonne vs $75 on Monday. -Tan Lee Lee (603-275-6834) ($1=2.5160 rgt)
